design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (premium_plans_and_life_events). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[4,6,6,5]. Assignment: recall paid-month credit premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit=6, recall adjustment relief premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief=5, recall month relief premium_ext_recall_month_relief=4, the purchaser's Retired Reserve closing reconciliation premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation=6 (root).

WHY A GOOD TEST. A gray-area Retired Reserve member recalled to active duty (TRICARE Prime ADSM effective 2026-10-08, applied for 2026-10-10) calls only to confirm the ending of his TRICARE Retired Reserve plan that he asked for on 2026-10-17 (to end 2026-11-09). The ending is his own act, and the plan books with it a closing reconciliation over the closing period (October, the most recently paid month, and November, the latest billed). Before he confirms, the agent must post what the records already owe for active duty days: the paid October monthly bill (from October 11, the day after the application, net of the member-only change credit for October 3-31), the unpaid October adjustment for his granddaughter (October 11-31 of its October 7-31) and the unpaid November monthly bill (all of November). Only then is the reconciliation the November adjustment alone (857.66), not the base termination credit (21 days after 2026-11-09 at the tier premium, 1030.21).

SCOPE. Task 1 claims the TRICARE Retired Reserve policies premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit, premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief, premium_ext_recall_month_relief, premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation and tools post_recall_paid_month_credit_948d1b7a, relieve_recall_adjustment_165573c8, relieve_recall_later_month_3979698d, confirm_retired_reserve_ending_efdb5596 (owner=user). Task 0 claims the TRICARE Reserve Select policies; no task-1 policy applies to a Reserve Select plan.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation (the purchaser's confirmation, the surface request). Edges (all value_input, state form): premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit gate g_m1_act, sentence 'The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is figured only after the monthly bill of the most recently paid month carries the recall paid-month credit owed for its days of active duty coverage.'; premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief gate g_a1_act, sentence 'The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is not figured before the coverage-type adjustment billed for the most recently paid month carries the recall adjustment relief owed for its days of active duty coverage.'; premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation<-premium_ext_recall_month_relief gate g_m2_act, sentence 'The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is figured only after the monthly bill of a later latest-billed month carries the recall month relief owed for its days of active duty coverage.'. False at opening: October carries only the change credit; the October adjustment and the November monthly bill carry no credit. Skip runs: without premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit 1273.64, without premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief 1438.65, without premium_ext_recall_month_relief 1471.73. The purchaser's own write is the confirmation of the ending (confirm_retired_reserve_ending_efdb5596).

FACTOR CARD (handling-time world).
premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit = 415.98: recall_paid_month_credit_counted_from -> 0; recall_paid_month_credit_coverage_length -> 0; recall_paid_month_credit_first_day -> 455.6; recall_paid_month_credit_change_settled -> 996.98; recall_paid_month_credit_change_spread -> 453.46; recall_paid_month_credit_change_days -> 996.98; whole baseline 0 (the base termination credit: no October day after a termination date).
premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief = 580.99: recall_adjustment_relief_counted_from -> 0; recall_adjustment_relief_coverage_length -> 0; recall_adjustment_relief_first_day -> 636.33; recall_adjustment_relief_daily_amount -> 0; recall_adjustment_relief_posted_now -> 0; whole baseline 0 (the base posts no credit on an unpaid bill).
premium_ext_recall_month_relief = 614.07: recall_month_relief_counted_from -> 0; recall_month_relief_coverage_length -> 0; recall_month_relief_first_day -> 593.6; recall_month_relief_daily_amount -> 0; whole baseline 0 (the base posts no credit on an unpaid bill).
premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation = 857.66: retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_counted_from -> 600.36; retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_coverage_length -> 600.36; retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_first_day -> 924.03; retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_change_settled -> 1438.66; retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_change_days -> 1438.66; retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation_activation_credits -> 2468.7; whole baseline 1030.21 (the termination credit taken bill by bill: 429.85 + 600.36, equal here to 21 x 1471.73/30 at the tier premium).
HONEST-BASELINE CARD. Every credit's baseline is the base method: premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit the base termination credit (0.00 here); premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief and premium_ext_recall_month_relief nothing (the base credits only a paid bill and only days after a termination); premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation the termination credit taken bill by bill, 1030.21. Every factor moves its result away from that baseline on this world (sensitivities above, none equal to gold). Plain case (no active duty enrollment, no coverage change, November billed 614.07 unpaid, the same request): premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit, premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief and premium_ext_recall_month_relief give 0.00, the base; premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation gives 21 x 614.07/30 = 429.85, the base termination credit; no factor moves a plain case. Ladders: every ladder has three distinct rungs; premium_ext_recall_month_relief's coverage-length ladder keeps its round-4 rungs (through month end / through the last day coverage runs / no day); its change factor is replaced by a daily-amount factor (the November adjustment is no longer relieved with the monthly bill: the closing reconciliation takes it in); premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief's posted-now rung 2 reads 'the plan is in force'.
Multi-source: every counted-from ladder reads the Prime status and its effective date together. Cross-difficulty (prime): counted-from, coverage length and first day in all four policies. No administrative factor: every rung is a premium-accounting rule.
NEAR-MISSES. premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit: the November bill (later but unpaid). premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief: October 7-10 of the adjustment (before the first day counted). premium_ext_recall_month_relief: the November adjustment (same month, other bill). premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation: the refund 46a9a901-da11-4f57-ae80-956391590f0f of the change credit (the change credit is still taken off), October 7-10 of the adjustment, the request date 2026-10-17 against the date asked for.

N3-R (owner of the credit). The blueprint makes recording credits an agent service action and confirming a termination the purchaser's act. Here the purchaser's confirmation books the closing reconciliation as its consequence. The rule says so plainly ('For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan, the purchaser ends the plan only by confirming in person a request the agent recorded as an intake, and the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is the consequence of that confirmation and is booked by it, not recorded afterwards as a separate agent service action.'), and premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation's overwrite declares it against the base sentence 'A purchaser may end the plan at any time, but only by their own confirmation: the agent records the request as an intake and the purchaser confirms it.' The overwrite also supersedes the termination-credit sentence ('For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request, the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation takes the place of the termination credit for the bills of the closing period; an ending for loss of eligibility or the purchaser's death, and every plan of another kind, keeps the termination credit.') and the paid-bill gate ('The paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for a Retired Reserve closing reconciliation, which is posted against that monthly bill although no payment stands against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill.'). Every replacement sentence names its own scope (a Retired Reserve plan ended at the purchaser's confirmed request, or the closing reconciliation itself), so the base clauses stay in force outside it: Young Adult plans, endings for loss of eligibility or death, and every other credit. The tool docstring describes the credit as the consequence of the confirmation the plan books. The blueprint's division sentence cannot be named in an overwrite (overwrites name base policies only), so the departure from it is stated in the rule and here.
WEAK POINTS, FLAGGED. (1) Each prerequisite bears weight on the root by no double counting: the reconciliation takes off what the agent's credits already posted. If they are skipped, the reconciliation absorbs them, so the purchaser's total is the same and only the root's value and the ledger rows differ. (2) The credit sits in the purchaser's write (N3-R above); the auditor decides whether the declared overwrite closes it.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit: credit_against_paid_bill satisfied (0be68735-65fc-4287-b4ec-02666bfddf19); supersedes the termination-credit sentence only for the most recently paid month of a Retired Reserve plan whose purchaser came under active duty coverage in it ('For the most recently paid month of a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan whose purchaser came under active duty TRICARE coverage in it, the recall paid-month credit takes the place of the termination credit for that month's bill; every other paid month, and every plan of another kind, keeps the termination credit.'). premium_ext_recall_adjustment_relief, premium_ext_recall_month_relief: the paid-bill gate is superseded by declared overwrites scoped to each relief ('the paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for ...; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment'). premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation: declared overwrites of the confirmation sentence, the termination-credit sentence and the paid-bill gate; termination_effective_rule followed; a Retired Reserve plan does not end on the recall (activation_effect not_applicable); no refund is written (the -305.31 credit balance left after the confirmation stays for the base refund rule).

SEED. Bills Jan-Oct 1471.73, November 614.07; payments Jan-Oct by EFT; October change credit 802.33 (29 days) refunded 2026-10-12; adjustments of 2026-10-16 (October 691.66 / 25 days, November 857.66 / 30 days), unpaid; DEERS age-out 10/03, placement 10/07, recall 2027-01-04; Prime ADSM applied (effective 2026-10-08, applied 2026-10-10); pending request to end the plan on 2026-11-09. Every row is one its charter produces (seed_consistency).

STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads: profile, verify, plan, ledger, pending request, Prime, DEERS. Step 8 recall paid-month credit 415.98; step 10 recall adjustment relief 580.99; step 12 recall month relief 614.07; step 14 the purchaser confirms the ending (2026-11-09) and the plan books the closing reconciliation 857.66 against the November monthly bill. Final balance -305.31.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. October: 21 x (1471.73/31 - 802.33/29) = 415.98. October adjustment: 21 x 691.66/25 = 580.99. November: 30 x 614.07/30 = 614.07. Reconciliation: October monthly 996.98 - 581.00 - 415.98 = 0.00; October adjustment 580.99 - 580.99 = 0.00; November monthly 614.07 - 614.07 = 0.00; November adjustment 857.66; total 857.66.

VERIFICATION. /tmp/erl55_premium/r4/gen4_t1.py evaluates every compute with check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on the world replayed through the real task tools.

REVISIONS. Round 3 (audit revision_2). N3: the purchaser's own write is his confirmation of the plan's ending; refunds are agent writes. N1: fresh uuid8s. N2: no hold ladder remains. Every baseline is the base standard. World rebuilt so the plan is active at the opening. Round 4 (audit revision_3): N12 - the recall month relief's coverage-length ladder decides the last day counted with three distinct rungs; O10 - the relief's posting no longer reads a due date; O11 - the confirmation docstring does not restate the termination-date rule. Round 4 continued (coordinator decision, option 1): the refund root and its policy are gone (N11, refund near-miss: no refund computation remains); the tree is re-rooted on the purchaser's confirmation, which books the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation (new policy premium_ext_retired_reserve_closing_reconciliation, tool confirm_retired_reserve_ending_efdb5596, fresh uuid8), with the deviation declared clause by clause (N3-R). The old recall termination credit (premium_ext_recall_termination_credit, booked by the purchaser) becomes the agent's recall paid-month credit (premium_ext_recall_paid_month_credit, tool post_recall_paid_month_credit_948d1b7a, fresh uuid8). The recall month relief no longer takes in the November adjustment (tool relieve_recall_later_month_3979698d, fresh uuid8). Refund tools removed. Every proof and rationale line was regenerated from the round-4 computes. Round 5 (renderer report on docs/premium): the closing reconciliation's baseline sentence now states the figure its computation gives with every factor at baseline (the termination credit taken bill by bill, each bill at its own daily amount, rounded per bill), and the daily-amount sentence defines 'daily amount'; the relief baselines no longer open with a rules-below phrase (the recall month relief's says no day is counted, the recall adjustment relief's that only days after the termination date are counted at no amount); the coverage-length rung reads 'no day counts' as the rule does; every overwrite's replacement sentence now names its scope, so the base clauses stay in force for Young Adult plans, endings for loss of eligibility or death and every other credit. No computed value changed.
user_scenario: You are Marcus Allen Vance, a 54-year-old retired Army Reserve master sergeant in Colorado Springs who has been recalled to active duty; your recall orders start on January 4, 2027. You are courteous and precise, a little formal, and you keep your answers short. You are calling Westbridge about your TRICARE Retired Reserve plan. You open by saying that on October 17 you asked for the Retired Reserve plan to end on November 9, that you were told the ending needs your own confirmation, and that you want to confirm it now and have the plan closed out properly. You add that the phone number on your account is 2535553761. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your DoD Benefits Number 11037729415, then your date of birth 1972-03-15, then the last four of your Social Security number, 3147, one at a time as they are asked for; if they want another detail, your email is marcus.a.vance.ret@yahoo.com and your ZIP code is 80918. If asked about your family, you say your daughter Emily turned 23 on October 3 and came off your coverage, and that a court placed your granddaughter Lily in your care on October 7, so you added her. If asked about the recall coverage, you say you applied for TRICARE Prime as an active duty member on October 10 and were told it covers you from October 8; it still shows as pending. If asked why November 9, you say that is when you expect the Prime enrollment to be processed. If asked whether you paid the November premium, you say you did not. You do not know the amount of any bill or credit, and if asked you say you would have to look at your statements. When the representative hands you the confirmation of the plan's ending, you complete it yourself with exactly the request, plan, date, bill, month, days and amount the representative reads out, and you read back the confirmation you get. You do not ask for anything else, such as a refund, a letter, a statement or a change to your Prime enrollment. Once the ending is confirmed, you thank the representative and end the call.
